name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-package-tree-discovery-service
description: Walks a directory tree for package.json files and reports which are eligible npm-registry release candidates and which were deliberately skipped, and why. Use when a registry build needs a package list and no one should have to hand-maintain one.

scripts.verify: node --check src/discover-npm-packages.mjs && node --check scripts/discover-npm-packages.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
